Have a question about "First Strike"
If a minion is granted First Strike (via Backstab or Blood Agony or is the
Muddled Vampire Hunter), if they do aggravated damage with that First
Strike, does the opposing minion get a strike that round? If not, do they
still declare their strike but it just fizzles? And if the opposing minion
has damage prevention (eg Skin of Steel), does
their strike come into effect?
Also, in the case of Muddles - if he equips with a Wooden Stake, does he
strike with the Wooden Stake for 4 points of damage, 3 of which would be
aggravated? The Wooden Stake cards says the minion inflicts hand damage as
a strike, but I just want to make certain.

thanx,
Sorrow

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
"Sorrow" <cbo...@apdi.net> writes:
>Have a question about "First Strike"
>If a minion is granted First Strike (via Backstab or Blood Agony or is the
>Muddled Vampire Hunter), if they do aggravated damage with that First

>Strike, does the opposing minion get a strike that round? If not, do they
>still declare their strike but it just fizzles? And if the opposing minion

>has damage prevention (eg Skin of Steel), does
>their strike come into effect?

The opposing minion's (vampire's) strike will not resolve if that minion
is no longer ready when the time comes for his strike to resolve.

In the case of aggravated damage that is unprevented (or normal damage
in excess of the vampire's blood, or any damage equal to an Ally's life),
then the combat will end during the "First Strike" resolution, before
the Normal strike reolution phase.

If the damage is prevented, then the opposing minon will still be ready,
and combat will continue as normal.

(If the opposing minion's strike is "Combat Ends" or "Dodge", then it
resolves before the "First Strike" anyhow, so ...)

>Also, in the case of Muddles - if he equips with a Wooden Stake, does he
>strike with the Wooden Stake for 4 points of damage, 3 of which would be
>aggravated? The Wooden Stake cards says the minion inflicts hand damage as
>a strike, but I just want to make certain.

Yes. 1 normal + 3 agg, all at first strike.
